age: Details of the BM-MSC donors: 40y/m (StemCell, MSC-001F, lot#BM2893), 39y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#1F3422), 27y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#318006), 20y/m (Lonza, PT2505, lot#8F3520).

cell_line.evidence: Permission to use the human embryonic stem cell line (hESC) ES04 (WiCell institute) was obtained from the Cornell/Rockefeller/Sloan Kettering tri-institutional ESC research oversight committee.

cell_type.evidence: Here we performed an in depth characterization of human ESC-MSC, comparing them to human bone marrow-derived MSC (BM-MSC) as well as human embryonic stem cells (hESC) by transcriptomics (RNA-seq) and quantitative proteomics (nanoLC-MS/MS using SILAC).

developmental_stage: A similar distance between the two MSC subtypes was observed (Figure S3).
